online_inputs_file: branches/inputs/<scene>.npz, arrays named t<checkpoint>_<field>; written once per snapshot before any continuation is run

online_inputs.rgb_history: uint8 [obs_horizon, H, W, 3 x cameras]; cameras in sorted name order, exactly what the policy receives
online_inputs.state_history: float32 [obs_horizon, D]; qpos, qvel, tcp_pose (the whitelist of src/hci/schema.py)
online_inputs.queue: float32 [n, 4]; unexecuted commands of the current chunk
online_inputs.policy_feature: float32; fixed encoder output of the frozen policy for the same history, + last action, t/horizon, queue fraction

diagnostic_privileged_only.scene JSON: initial_state, snapshots[].s: cube poses, grasp/on-cube/static flags, stage labels read from simulator ground truth
diagnostic_privileged_only.branches/traces/<scene>.npz: per-step TCP, cube positions, flags, success, executed action, gripper joint positions, phase; `ref_<checkpoint>` is the R5 control-only reference run

rule: Nothing of the diagnostic group is written into the online input file, given to the policy, or used for a control target. No model was trained in this stage.
online_proprioception_in_traces: gripper_qpos_1/2 are the last two entries of the qpos observation the policy already receives; logged per step to tell the gripper command from the finger position. They are not a new policy input.
controller_inputs_of_the_matched_arms: measured TCP position, the snapshot TCP position, the last gripper command, T_ref. No object pose, no task flag, no outcome.
